track.title: Afshari
track.notes: Tagged title: Afshari. Same performance as 'The Masters of Persian Traditional Music, Sehtar' (1991) track 5; that transfer runs 0.90% slower (onset alignment), about 16 cents lower if the speed carries the pitch.

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on C5 and dwells most on C in Phrase 1. Phrase 9 (1:52.6) introduces Eb, centred on C. Phrase 12 (2:34.6) introduces D, Bb, centred on C. Phrase 18 (3:38.4) introduces F, centred on Eb. Phrase 20 (4:03.1) introduces G, centred on C. Phrase 23 (4:36.5) introduces Ak, centred on C. Phrase 30 (6:29.0) introduces Ek, centred on C. The line peaks at D5 (579.4 Hz) at 2:41.6. It closes on the tonic (F4 → C3 → F4 → C3 → C3 → C4).
